title: Sensata Technologies Holding plc and Certain Subsidiaries Announce Early Tender Results and Amendment of Cash Tender Offers
summary: Sensata Technologies Holding plc (NYSE: ST) (“Sensata”) and its indirect, wholly owned subsidiaries Sensata Technologies B.V. (“STBV”) and Sensata Technologies, Inc. (“STI”) (each subsidiary, an “Offeror” and collectively, the “Offerors”) announced today the early tender results of the Offerors’ previously announced tender offers (each, individually with respect to the relevant series of senior notes, a “Tender Offer” with respect to such series, and collectively, the “Tender Offers”) to purchase up to $350,000,000 in total cash consideration payable, excluding the applicable accrued and unpaid interest (the “Maximum Tender Offer Amount”), for certain senior notes issued by the respective Offerors (collectively, the “Notes”).
